title: KRAS conformational exchange
abstract: We measured KRAS CPMG relaxation dispersion.

title: Dynamics of a KRAS mutant
abstract: We measured CEST and R1rho in a KRAS mutant.

title: KRAS flexibility
abstract: We measured R1, R2 and heteronuclear NOE in KRAS.

title: KRAS crystal conformers
abstract: Multitemperature crystal structures reveal alternate conformers.

title: KRAS distances
abstract: We used FRET and DEER to measure conformational changes.

title: KRAS simulations
abstract: MD simulations only, without new experimental measurements.

title: N-Ras exchange
abstract: N-Ras, a KRAS paralog, was measured with CPMG.

title: Review of KRAS dynamics
abstract: This review discusses published KRAS NMR measurements.

title: RNase A measurements
abstract: We measured RNase A CPMG relaxation dispersion, not KRAS.

title: KRAS exchange broadening and PRE
abstract: We measured exchange broadening, PRE and RDC in KRAS.
